verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence lets a user choose the region where GA4 stores data. The closest items are adjacent controls: an EU collection endpoint for the Measurement Protocol (it routes where data is collected, not where it is stored), data-retention settings (how long data is kept, not where), and BigQuery export (a host-platform feature with no documented location choice). None of these earn credit for storage residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
